new_sources.name: African-Languages-Lab/multi-open
new_sources.size: 10M-100M parallel translation pairs across 32+ African languages + English
new_sources.description: Large-scale parallel machine translation dataset for 32+ African languages paired with English. Part of the African Languages Lab (All Lab) initiative. Associated with ACL 2026 Main Conference paper 'The African Languages Lab: A Collaborative Approach to Advancing Low-Resource Language Technologies'. Quality-controlled data collection pipeline yielding 19 billion text tokens and 12,628 hours of aligned speech data across 40 languages. 612 downloads as of 2026-07-14.
new_sources.search_keywords: African language parallel corpus low-resource ACL 2026

new_sources.name: African-Languages-Lab/all-lab-speech
new_sources.size: 10M-100M speech samples, 12,628 hours aligned speech data
new_sources.category: 预训练语料/低资源语言
new_sources.description: Large-scale multilingual speech dataset for 40 African languages with word-level alignment. Part of the African Languages Lab initiative. Supports ASR, TTS, and speech recognition tasks. 12,628 hours of aligned speech data. Accompanied by text corpora (19 billion tokens). Released alongside ACL 2026 paper.
new_sources.search_keywords: African language speech ASR TTS All Lab

new_sources.name: nvidia/Nemotron-SFT-Multilingual-v2
new_sources.size: 100K-1M SFT samples covering code, math, science, reasoning domains
new_sources.description: NVIDIA's official multilingual SFT dataset v2. Covers English, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, and Portuguese across code generation, mathematics, science, and reasoning domains. 100K-1M high-quality samples. Part of the Nemotron 3 Ultra training pipeline. 2,694 downloads (3,301 all-time). Released alongside Nemotron-SFT-Multilingual-v1 (2026-03-11, 3,020 downloads). CC-BY-4.0 licensed. Community derivatives include prompt-only variants and Amharic adaptations.

new_sources.name: hasankursun/multilingual-safety-classification-dataset
new_sources.description: Comprehensive multilingual safety and content moderation classification dataset covering 60 languages including African, Asian, European, and Middle Eastern languages. Supports safety classification and content moderation tasks. 3,413 downloads (highest among new multilingual safety datasets in this window). CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 licensed.
new_sources.search_keywords: multilingual safety classification content moderation 60 languages
